kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انهزلت (form VII)
# اِنْهَزَلْتُ (inhazaltu) /in.ha.zal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# اِنْهَزَلْتَ (inhazalta) /in.ha.zal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# اِنْهَزَلْتِ (inhazalti) /in.ha.zal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# اِنْهَزَلَتْ (inhazalat) /in.ha.za.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
